au_first_names.txt.transformation: Official DataStore API records for Top 100 Baby Names 2024: Girl Names/Count of Girl Names and Boy Names/Count of Boy Names; sum counts across sexes, omit null name/count cells. Require all records (total) in response. Queensland births only, not all Australia. Strip outer whitespace, normalize Unicode NFC; reject empty values and values containing anything other than Unicode letters/combining marks, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens. Merge identical normalized names by summing counts. Select at most 5000 names by descending total count, breaking ties by Unicode name; emit selected names in Unicode alphabetical order, UTF-8, LF, final newline. The existing one-name-per-line format supports uniform sampling only: counts rank the capped selection but are not sampling weights.

Preserve upstream spelling and case. Provincial birth registrations, not all Canada.
